verdict.rationale: The README documents an opt-in `x-markdown-chunking` header that semantically chunks the markdown response. It returns a JSON array (or delimited text) of chunks instead of one blob, which directly matches the story. Reader is also positioned as feeding RAG systems. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of chunk quality, and documentation of chunk-size controls or per-chunk metadata beyond a single README line.
